text:
kevin_platform: thinking out loud — propose we do a small canary that routes requests based on API key tier + project budget remaining. goal: divert "low-risk" traffic to cheaper dedicated pools when budget allows, fall back to hosted otherwise. want minimal console UX changes but clear telemetry/reason codes so biz teams trust it.

maria_dev: sounds sensible. how do you define "low-risk"? is key tier enough or do we need rate/usage history?

kevin_platform: start conservative: key_tier (gold/silver/bronze) + project_budget_pct > 10% + recent error_rate < 0.5%. keep it simple for initial rollout.

rahul_infra: telemetry wise we need: route_decision, decision_reasons (budget_tier, error_rate, fallback), tokenized cost_delta estimate, and canary_id. also important: sampling of prompts for quality checks.

kevin_platform: agreed. want structured reason codes so dashboards can filter: eg "budget_ok", "error_ok", "policy_match", "forced_fallback".

kevin_platform: example policy sketch:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  match:
    key_tier: silver
    project_budget_remaining_pct: ">10"
    recent_error_rate: "<0.5"
  route: dedicated-lowcost
  canary: 5%
  fallback: hosted-standard
  reason_code: budget_based_routing
```

maria_dev: tiny nit — project_budget_remaining_pct needs to be read from billing projection, not raw balance. otherwise sudden spikes cause thrash.

dana_product: for console UX: show per-key routing history (last 24h) and a single line that says why a request was routed elsewhere. also a toggle to opt-out project-wide. don't show raw budget numbers to end users, just status "Healthy / Near-limit / Over-limit".

tony_sre: +1 on opt-out. Also we need a circuit-breaker policy: if dedicated pool latency > SLO or error_rate spikes, flip that canary to 0 immediately and mark reason_code "pool_unhealthy".

rahul_infra: implement metrics: routing_decisions_total{reason="$REASON"}, routing_cost_delta_estimated_sum, routing_fallback_count. expose as prometheus and forward key-level aggregates to billing pipeline nightly.

kevin_platform: what about auth surface? Does the routing decision require additional scopes on keys? worried about mixing org-level vs project-level keys.

maria_dev: we should evaluate at the effective project context. service accounts owned by org but used across projects should inherit the most conservative budget rule among target projects. otherwise attribution/billing gets messy.

kevin_platform: ok: decision order: 1) explicit key override (metadata) 2) project-level budget+policy 3) org-level default. fallback to hosted. we'll add a clear audit trail.

ops-bot: canary created: id=canary-42, policy=budget_based_routing, initial_pop=5% 

dana_product: action items: 1) infra to add reason_code fields + metrics (rahul), 2) platform to implement policy engine + canary flag (kevin/maria), 3) product to spec console rows + opt-out (dana). timeline: small internal canary in 2 weeks, public beta in 6.

tony_sre: also add alerting: fallback_rate > 2% for 10m -> page.

maria_dev: will prototype config parser and include unit tests for precedence. posting PR link when ready.

kevin_platform: thanks — will sync with billing team re: budget projection API. if no objections I'll open RFC later today.
